## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-*juan* Sòng-period running commentary on Zhànrán's *Jīn-gāng-bēi* ([KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175), T1932) by the Tiāntái master **Shíjǔ** 時舉, with editorial collation (會 *huì*) by the late-Míng monk **Hǎiyǎn** 海眼 (the *Bìng tóu-tuó* "Sick *Dhutaṅga*"). The work belongs together with the other Sòng *Jīn-gāng-bēi* commentaries ([KR6d0177](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0177), [KR6d0178](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0178), [KR6d0179](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0179), [KR6d0180](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0180)) as part of the substantial Sòng commentarial corpus on Zhànrán's foundational doctrine.

**Abstract**

The composition of the original Shíjǔ commentary is bracketed within the Sòng productive period c. 1100–1300; the editorial finalisation by Hǎiyǎn extends the bracket into the late-Míng era (c. 1600). The work was preserved through the Sòng-Míng commentarial transmission and reprinted in the Manji-zoku canonical apparatus.
